description:
Spot insider buying EARLY: companies where fewer than 5 different insiders bought in the window but the pace is
rising (more buyers or more dollars recently than earlier), versus 'crowded' companies where 5+ insiders already
bought. Explains exactly how 'rising' is measured. Use for 'which stocks have early, increasing insider buying
that is not crowded yet?', 'emerging insider signals'.
